title.en: A Way Out, a Way Forward: five new complete editions
title.zh: 离得开，有得选：新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 離得開，有得選：新增五語全文

summary.en: 3 essays now in complete Japanese, French, German, Spanish and Korean, alongside English and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Fictional cases, objections and normative limits retained.
summary.zh: 3 篇散文新增日、法、德、西、韩完整版本，保留英文及简繁中文，逐段保留虚构案例、反方论证与规范边界。
summary.zh-hant: 3 篇散文新增日、法、德、西、韓完整版本，保留英文及簡繁中文，逐段保留虛構案例、反方論證與規範邊界。
